text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems both <chrname> and you are steadily 
achieving growth.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
However, everyone puts in relentless 
effort just the same. I cannot allow 
myself to stop at mere self-satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Grow stronger. Keep pursuing strength 
great enough to gouge the earth... and 
carve your hoofprints deep into the 
ground.
